university.name: Leeds Trinity University
university.summary: Leeds Trinity University has a main campus at Horsforth and a Leeds City Campus. Its schools include Business and Law and Computing and Creative Industries, and it teaches undergraduate and postgraduate courses. Its international postgraduate page lists 19 courses open to students who need a study visa.

courses.title: Computer Science
courses.overview: A taught Master's at the Leeds City Campus covering cloud computing, secure software development, artificial intelligence and responsible computing, finishing with an independent project. Assessment includes reports, presentations, portfolios and software artefacts.
courses.academic_requirements: January 2027 entry: honours degree (2:2 or above) in a relevant STEM or Computing subject, or honours degree (2:1 or above) in a non-relevant discipline, or at least three years of relevant experience. September 2026 entry (now closed) also allowed a 2:2 in an unrelated subject plus industry experience, or a three-year non-honours STEM bachelor's plus one year of industry experience, or a pre-masters.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS Academic 6.0 overall with no component below 5.5. PTE Academic 59 overall and in each component. Duolingo English Test 105 overall with no component below 100. TOEFL iBT: for exams taken before 21 January 2026 total 79 (Reading 18, Listening 17, Speaking 20, Writing 17); for exams taken after that date overall grade 4 with at least 4 in each component. Other tests are listed on the English language requirements page.
courses.experience_requirements: Relevant industry experience is an alternative route for some applicants, as set out in the academic requirements.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Pakistan page: four-year Bachelor's degree from a recognised university needs 55% or a GPA of 2.5 (GPA scale not stated). Two or three year Bachelor's followed by a two-year Master's: 55% or a GPA of 2.5. The same page states that applications from Pakistan are currently closed.
courses.career_notes: The course page has no careers section. It refers to specialist knowledge, practical skills for professional settings and networking with industry professionals.
courses.application_deadline_note: International postgraduate page: direct applications are open for January 2027 starts; September 2027 applications open later. International postgraduate applications are not eligible for deferred entry.
courses.notes: Fee is the published 2026/27 international fee; target year fee not yet published. The course page itself shows September 2026 (closed) and January 2027 (open) starts; September 2027 is taken from the international postgraduate page. Part-time study is not open to international students.

courses.title: International Business
courses.overview: A taught Master's in the School of Business and Law at the Leeds City Campus, covering international supply chains, cross-cultural management, sustainability and business ethics, with a research project or dissertation. Assessment includes case studies and presentations.
courses.academic_requirements: January 2027 entry: honours degree (2:2 or above) in any discipline, or at least three years of relevant experience. September 2026 entry (now closed): honours degree (2:2 or above) in any discipline, or at least six years at management level.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS Academic 6.0 overall with no component below 5.5. PTE Academic 59 overall and in each component. Duolingo English Test 105 overall with no component below 100. TOEFL iBT: for exams taken before 21 January 2026 total 79 (Reading 18, Listening 17, Speaking 20, Writing 17); for exams taken after that date overall grade 4 with at least 4 in each component. Taken from the English language requirements page for most postgraduate programmes.
courses.experience_requirements: Management or relevant work experience is an alternative to a degree, as set out in the academic requirements.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Pakistan page: four-year Bachelor's degree from a recognised university needs 55% or a GPA of 2.5 (GPA scale not stated). Two or three year Bachelor's followed by a two-year Master's: 55% or a GPA of 2.5. The same page states that applications from Pakistan are currently closed.
courses.career_notes: The page states the course aims to start a career as a manager and business specialist, and students can use the Leeds Trinity Business Network.
courses.application_deadline_note: International postgraduate page: direct applications are open for January 2027 starts; September 2027 applications open later. International postgraduate applications are not eligible for deferred entry.
courses.notes: Fee is the published 2026/27 international fee; target year fee not yet published. The course page shows September 2026 (closed) and January 2027 (open) starts; September 2027 is taken from the international postgraduate page. The course page gives no English scores, so those come from the English language requirements page. Part-time study is not open to Student Route visa holders.

courses.title: Law
courses.overview: A one-year practical law Master's in the School of Business and Law, aimed at non-law graduates and people working in legal roles. It is partly aligned with aspects of the Solicitors Qualifying Examination and ends with a dissertation.
courses.academic_requirements: January 2027 entry: honours degree at 2:2 or above in any subject, or at least three years of relevant experience. September 2026 entry (now closed): honours degree at 2:2 or above in any subject, or equivalent professional experience.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS Academic 6.0 overall with no component below 5.5. PTE Academic 59 overall and in each component. Duolingo English Test 105 overall with no component below 100. TOEFL iBT: for exams taken before 21 January 2026 total 79 (Reading 18, Listening 17, Speaking 20, Writing 17); for exams taken after that date overall grade 4 with at least 4 in each component. Taken from the English language requirements page for most postgraduate programmes.
courses.experience_requirements: Relevant experience is an alternative to a degree, as set out in the academic requirements.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Pakistan page: four-year Bachelor's degree from a recognised university needs 55% or a GPA of 2.5 (GPA scale not stated). Two or three year Bachelor's followed by a two-year Master's: 55% or a GPA of 2.5. The same page states that applications from Pakistan are currently closed.
courses.career_notes: The page lists possible roles including solicitor, barrister, legal executive, paralegal, legal technologist and patent attorney, after further study and training where relevant.
courses.application_deadline_note: International postgraduate page: direct applications are open for January 2027 starts; September 2027 applications open later. International postgraduate applications are not eligible for deferred entry.
courses.notes: Fee is the published 2026/27 international fee; target year fee not yet published. The course page shows September 2026 (closed) and January 2027 (open) starts; September 2027 is taken from the international postgraduate page. Nine modules are listed, all core; four are shown as highlights.

courses.title: Business Management
courses.overview: A three-year undergraduate degree at the Leeds City Campus covering marketing, accounting and finance, people management and the global business environment. The page lists CIMA exemptions from up to four professional exams and a placement route.
highlights: Year 1 core: Principles of Accounting and Finance
courses.academic_requirements: UCAS tariff of 112 points is shown on the course page; A-levels, BTECs and T Levels are accepted. International academic requirements for this course are not shown on the course page.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS Academic 6.0 overall with no component below 5.5. PTE Academic 59 overall and in each component. Duolingo English Test 105 overall with no component below 100. TOEFL iBT: for exams taken before 21 January 2026 total 79 (Reading 18, Listening 17, Speaking 20, Writing 17); for exams taken after that date overall grade 4 with at least 4 in each component. Taken from the English language requirements page for most undergraduate programmes.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: The Pakistan page states that applications from Pakistan are currently closed. It gives no intermediate-level requirement for undergraduate entry; its only undergraduate line concerns a bachelor's degree taken over two or more years.
courses.career_notes: The page states graduates are prepared for managerial roles, management trainee roles or postgraduate study.
courses.application_deadline_note: International undergraduate applications are made through UCAS (institution code L24).
courses.notes: Fee is the published 2026/27 international undergraduate fee; target year fee not yet published. The course page shows a September 2026 start and a 2027 entry option with no start month, so no intake is recorded. International undergraduate entry requirements (Pakistan or A-level) could not be found. The 112 UCAS points figure is from the course page and is not specific to international applicants.

scholarships.name: Postgraduate first-year tuition scholarship
scholarships.value_text: GBP 3,100 off first-year tuition on listed courses (GBP 3,350 for the MBA)
scholarships.summary: A first-year tuition reduction listed on the international tuition fees page for named postgraduate courses, including MSc Computer Science, MA International Business and LLM Law. No application is needed.
scholarships.criteria_text: Applies to the named postgraduate courses on the international tuition fees page. First year only. No application needed.
scholarships.intake_label: Terms as published on the 2026/27 fees page; 2027/28 terms not stated
scholarships.notes: The page does not name the scholarship or state the academic year it applies to, so the name is descriptive. Applications from Pakistan are currently closed according to the Pakistan page.

scholarships.name: Postgraduate alumni discount
scholarships.value_text: 20% to 50% off tuition depending on Leeds Trinity undergraduate degree class (50% first, 35% 2:1, 20% 2:2)
scholarships.summary: A tuition discount for Leeds Trinity graduates who achieved a 2:2 or above in an undergraduate degree, applying to MA and MSc programmes. The page says it may change for 2027/28 entry.
scholarships.criteria_text: Leeds Trinity graduates with a 2:2 or above in an undergraduate degree. PGCE Provider-led, School Direct and SCITT courses are excluded.
scholarships.notes: value_percent shows the maximum tier. The page does not state how the discount is claimed or whether it applies per year, so application_route and value_basis are null. Only relevant to Pakistani applicants who graduated from Leeds Trinity.
